_comment: Three separate environments (masterplan §26, backend plan B6.4). Each has its own Supabase project and Vercel project; nothing is shared except code. Checked by scripts/check-environment.mjs and tests/unit/environments.test.ts.

development.supabase: local (supabase start) or a personal dev project

staging.supabase: separate hosted project, no real citizen data
staging.vercel: separate project, preview and staging domain

production.supabase: separate hosted project, region documented in docs/aibc/data-sovereignty.md
